verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official CLI (vercel-probe-4, vercel-gh-1) that supports git push-to-deploy and scriptable deployment, plus a documented REST/OpenAPI API (vercel-probe-3) enabling headless automation in CI pipelines. Docs also reference agent-driven deployment flows (vercel-docs-10) supporting non-interactive/automated usage. Missing for 10: no explicit CI-specific documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions integration guide) or independent hands-on report confirming headless CLI use in CI environments.
